verses.raw: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them.<sup foot_note=256642>1</sup> It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?
